[size=4]This mod adds 6 new fountains, animated by animation master: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24986819]Gervig91[/url] !
A beautiful addition for your farm, greenhouse, and even indoor gardens! 

[b]UPDATED FOR 1.6[/b] - This mod now uses [b]Content Patcher[/b] and no longer requires DGA as it is discontinued.

The fountains are now instant-build buildings you can craft at Robin's. They also act as water sources for you to refill your watering can!
